Grievance Redressal

Effective 5 October 2026 · Version 2026-10-05

We want to fix problems quickly. This page explains how to complain and what happens next, as required by the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

Grievance Officer

  • Name: [grievance_officer_name not set]
  • Designation: Grievance Officer
  • Email: [grievance_email not set]
  • Address: [operator_name not set], [operator_address not set]

What you can complain about

  • content or behaviour on AstroBro that breaks our Terms of Use or the law;
  • an astrologer's or pandit's conduct;
  • payments, refunds, the wallet, plans, reports or bookings;
  • your personal data, including requests to see, correct or erase it or to withdraw consent (Privacy Policy);
  • problems with your account.

How to complain

Email [grievance_email not set] from your registered email address and include:

  • what happened and when;
  • the payment ID, consultation or booking concerned, if any;
  • screenshots or other details that help;
  • what you would like us to do.

If you are asking us to remove content, tell us where it appears. If you are asking about your personal data, tell us which right you want to use.

Our timelines

  • We acknowledge every complaint within 24 hours.
  • We resolve complaints within 15 days of receiving them.
  • We act within 24 hours on a complaint about content that shows a person's private areas, shows them in full or partial nudity or in a sexual act, or impersonates them (including morphed images).
  • We act within 72 hours on a request to remove other content that breaks the rules in section 8 of the Terms of Use.
  • We follow orders from courts and government agencies within the time the law sets.

If you are not satisfied

  • Grievance Appellate Committee: for complaints about content or our decisions as a platform, you can appeal within 30 days of our Grievance Officer's decision at gac.gov.in.
  • Consumer complaints: call the National Consumer Helpline on 1915 or visit consumerhelpline.gov.in. You can also approach the Consumer Commission.
  • Personal data: you can complain to the Data Protection Board of India after using our grievance process.
  • Cyber fraud: call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.

Emergencies

AstroBro cannot respond to emergencies. Call 112 for emergencies or Tele-MANAS on 14416 for mental health support.
